# `csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style`

chop_always gives every initializer element its own line. Only honoured in deterministic mode.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `chop_always` |  |
| `chop_if_long` |  |

**Default:** `chop_if_long`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public object Make()
    {
        return new Point { X = 1, Y = 2, Z = 3 };
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always`

```ini
csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public object Make()
    {
        return new Point
        {
            X = 1,
            Y = 2,
            Z = 3
        };
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_if_long`

```ini
csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_if_long
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
